caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object with intricate parts and components. The primary structure is composed of a dark, possibly black, metal base with two circular holes positioned vertically, and a third circular feature near the base, with visible bolts or rivets along its surface. One side of the object has a decorated, silver-colored plate, adorned with etched swirls and circular patterns, as well as raised, rounded studs forming a curved line. Near the top of the object is a rectangular, silver panel with two round motifs, and next to it is a lever or latch extending diagonally upwards, appearing in a beige to light tan color. The drawing is composed on plain, off-white or cream-colored paper and is signed at the bottom right with the text “ROSE - CAMPBELL - GERKE.” There are no additional objects or background elements.
